body_markdown:
A 250-mile stretch of airspace between Texas and New Mexico could become a dedicated test corridor for supersonic and hypersonic flights under a proposal backed by four US organizations. The route would connect Midland International Air & Space Port in West Texas with Spaceport America in southern New Mexico, giving researchers a place to measure sonic booms and study how high-speed flights could fit into civilian air traffic.
